nodes.title: v2: pivot to Base + mass-adoption features
nodes.description:
Strategic rewrite: pivot from Solana/Anchor to Base (Coinbase L2) with Coinbase Smart Wallet for gasless UX. Adds draw outcomes, arbiter dispute resolution, 4-owner treasury split, per-participant social-share fee discount (2.5%→1.5%), winner dunk GIFs with auto-social-post, Discord OAuth on the web, and a public bet explorer.

Decisions locked in:
- Chain: Base (Solidity + Foundry)
- Social fee discount: per-participant (each side independently earns 1% off their half)
- Arbiter: reuse ADMIN_DISCORD_IDS
- Draw: full refund, no fee
- 4 treasury wallets split fee evenly (0.625% each at 2.5% total)
- Arbiter fee: max($100, 1% of pot), comes out of pot

MVP (Solana) code stays in repo as reference; DB schema + Discord bot state machine + flows.ts carry over unchanged.

nodes.title: Set up Foundry workspace (apps/contracts)
nodes.description: Scaffold apps/contracts/ with Foundry (forge). Install OpenZeppelin contracts, solmate for gas-efficient SafeTransferLib. Add pnpm script `contracts:build`, `contracts:test`. Delete apps/program/ or rename to apps/program-solana-reference/ for archival.

nodes.title: Port escrow to Solidity + add v2 features
nodes.description:
Write CozyBetEscrow.sol. Port the 4 Anchor instructions to Solidity functions + add v2 features.

**Constructor/init**: owner admin + 4 owner treasury addresses + arbiter role (set to admin) + base fee_bps (default 250).

**Functions:**
- initializeBet(betId, amount, challenger, accepter, challengerFeeBps, accepterFeeBps, tokenAddr): creates Bet struct, per-side fee bps (default 250 each, reduced to 150 if they've shared)
- deposit(betId): requires msg.sender == challenger|accepter, pulls USDC via transferFrom to this contract
- resolve(betId, winner): resolver-only. Computes fee = sum of per-side fees (default 500bps of pot), split 4 ways to treasuries, rest to winner.
- draw(betId): resolver-only. Refunds each side full stake (no fee).
- refund(betId): resolver-only. Refunds deposited sides.
- arbiterResolve(betId, winner): arbiter-only. Computes arbiter fee = max(ARBITER_MIN_USDC, pot/100), sends to arbiter address, rest split normally.
- setFeeBpsForSide(betId, side, bps): resolver-only. Applies social-share discount.

**Access control:** Use OpenZeppelin AccessControl. Roles: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, RESOLVER_ROLE, ARBITER_ROLE.

**Storage:** Bet struct with packed fields. Mapping betId → Bet.

**USDC:** ERC20 interface, takes mint (aka token) address at init. Use Circle's Base Sepolia USDC: 0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e.

**Events:** BetInitialized, Deposited, Resolved, Drawn, Refunded, ArbiterResolved, FeeDiscountApplied.

**Tests (Foundry):** mirror the 4 Solana scenarios + draw + arbiter + discount. At least 15 test cases.

nodes.title: Deploy to Base Sepolia testnet + init config
nodes.description:
Use Foundry's `forge create` or `forge script` to deploy CozyBetEscrow to Base Sepolia (chainId 84532). RPC: https://sepolia.base.org.

Get testnet USDC from Circle's Base Sepolia faucet (https://faucet.circle.com) and distribute to test wallets.

Write scripts/contracts/deploy.s.sol and scripts/contracts/init-config.s.sol. Add pnpm script `contracts:deploy:sepolia`.

Base Sepolia faucet for ETH (gas): https://www.coinbase.com/faucets/base-ethereum-sepolia-faucet

nodes.title: Swap @solana/web3.js → viem + generate contract types
nodes.description:
Replace Solana client libs with EVM equivalents.

- `apps/bot/src/solana.ts` → `apps/bot/src/chain.ts`: use viem's walletClient + publicClient. Load bot-resolver as hex private key. Helpers: initializeBetOnChain, resolveOnChain, refundOnChain, drawOnChain, arbiterResolveOnChain, fetchBetOnChain.
- `packages/shared/src/`: export ABI + contract address from a central location. Use wagmi-cli or foundry's `forge build` to generate TS types from the ABI.
- `apps/web/lib/program.ts` → `apps/web/lib/contract.ts`: use wagmi hooks (useWriteContract, useReadContract).

All state machine + DB + Discord code in flows.ts stays unchanged — just the chain adapter changes.

nodes.title: Coinbase Smart Wallet + wagmi integration on web
nodes.description:
Replace @solana/wallet-adapter with wagmi + Coinbase Smart Wallet SDK.

- Install wagmi, @coinbase/wallet-sdk (Smart Wallet preset), viem.
- Update apps/web/app/providers.tsx: WagmiProvider with Base Sepolia chain + Coinbase Smart Wallet connector.
- Update /fund/[betId]/page.tsx: use `useWriteContract` from wagmi.
- Update /link/[sessionId]/page.tsx: use `useSignMessage` from wagmi.

Coinbase Smart Wallet is a passkey-backed wallet — users just click a button, authenticate with their device biometric, and they have a wallet. No seed phrase.

nodes.title: Bot: /draw slash command + flow
nodes.description:
New slash command /draw <bet_id>. When one participant runs it, record their claim. When both participants have claimed draw, call draw() on-chain → DB status → 'drawn' (new enum value), announce in channel.

Add `drawn` to BetStatus enum (both in shared + db pgEnum + migration). Add `drawClaim` tracking fields to bets table (like challengerClaimsWinner/accepterClaimsWinner but for draw).

Update announcement card rendering to handle 'drawn' state.

Flow mirrors claimWinner — needs parallel in flows.ts.

nodes.title: Bot: /requestarbiter + dispute flow
nodes.description:
New slash command /requestarbiter <bet_id>. Either participant can request an arbiter when bet is Funded or Disputed.

On request:
1. DB status → 'disputed' (if not already)
2. DM all admins in ADMIN_DISCORD_IDS with bet details + both users' Discord tags + 'claim evidence via DM' buttons
3. Channel announcement: 'Arbiter requested. Admin will review.'

Add `arbiter_requested_at` + `arbiter_discord_id` fields to bets table.

nodes.title: Bot: Arbiter proof collection + decision flow
nodes.description:
When an admin claims an arbiter case, they DM both participants with a prompt: 'Please reply with evidence (screenshots, links). You have 48h.' Participants' replies to the bot are stored (bet_events with type='arbiter_evidence').

Admin views evidence via /arbiter-review <bet_id> (shows all collected evidence in one ephemeral embed). Then /arbiter-decide <bet_id> <winner|draw> makes the call, which invokes arbiterResolve() on-chain (pays arbiter fee from pot, distributes rest).

Add arbiter_fee field on resolve events so the UI can show it.

nodes.title: Bot: /share + X (Twitter) verification + discount
nodes.description:
After a bet is Accepted (but not yet Funded), participants can run /share <bet_id>. Bot returns an ephemeral message with:
- A prefilled X/Twitter tweet text including a hashtag + the bet description + link to /bet/[id]
- A link to X compose UI with that text prefilled
- A /confirm-share <bet_id> <tweet_url> follow-up

When user posts the /confirm-share, bot hits X API v2 (GET /2/tweets/:id) to verify the tweet exists, comes from the claimed user's X account (linked ahead of time via /linktwitter, scope tweet.read users.read), and contains our hashtag. On verification, call setFeeBpsForSide() on-chain (reduces that side's fee from 250 to 150 bps).

Add `x_handle` field to users table. Add `share_tweet_url` field to bets table (per-side: challenger_share_url, accepter_share_url).

Env: X_BEARER_TOKEN, X_CLIENT_ID/SECRET for OAuth.

nodes.title: Bot: Winner dunk GIF picker + social post
nodes.description:
After resolve (winner is set), DM winner with a StringSelectMenu containing ~10 curated trash-talk GIFs from a config file (apps/bot/src/dunks.ts: array of {url, label}). Winner picks one; bot:
1. Posts in the bet's channel: '<winner> dunks on <loser>: <gif>' embed.
2. DMs winner a Twitter share button with prefilled tweet including the GIF url.

Add `dunk_gif_url` and `dunk_posted_at` fields to bets table. GIF list in config, replaceable without redeploy via env or a CSV file.

nodes.title: Web: Discord OAuth login (replaces magic-link)
nodes.description:
Install NextAuth or @auth/next. Add DiscordProvider. New routes:
- /login: 'Continue with Discord' button
- /api/auth/[...nextauth]: OAuth callback
- Session includes discord_id, discord_username, avatar

Replace the magic-link /link/[sessionId] route's flow: user lands on /link (via Discord DM link with Discord OAuth redirect), signs in with Discord, connects Smart Wallet, signs ownership message, POSTs to bot to register wallet.

Rationale: removes the 15-min magic-link session + manual discord_id entry. Users prove their Discord identity via OAuth.

nodes.title: Web: Public bet explorer / verifier page
nodes.description:
New Next.js route /explorer showing the last 100 bets (or a paged list). Columns: bet id, status, amount, challenger Discord tag (or anonymous), accepter, winner, resolution tx (link to basescan.org/tx/X). Read-only; auth-free.

Also /bet/[id] (already exists) gets a 'Verify on-chain' link + shows tx hash.

Implements the 'system or website for tracking blocks and verifying transactions' from the spec.

nodes.title: Web: User account page (wallet + history + share status)
nodes.description: Signed-in user (via Discord OAuth) gets /me: shows their linked wallet, USDC balance, active + historical bets, X account status, current fee rate (2.5% vs 1.5% if share verified).

nodes.title: Ops: 4-owner treasury withdraw + reserve logic
nodes.description:
Contract keeps a threshold of USDC + ETH on-hand for ops (recommend $100 USDC + 0.01 ETH). When fees collected exceed the threshold, distribute split evenly to 4 owner wallets automatically on resolve. Or: manual /treasury-sweep admin command that triggers distribution.

Implement as part of resolve() in the contract OR as a separate withdraw(). Tradeoff: per-resolve auto-split adds a little gas cost but saves admin clicks.

Add TREASURY_ADDRESSES env (comma-separated), MIN_RESERVE_USDC env.

nodes.title: Ops: Coinbase Paymaster for gasless UX
nodes.description:
Configure Coinbase Developer Platform Paymaster so user-initiated transactions (deposit, social share-trigger, etc.) are sponsored by us. Users never need ETH.

Steps: create Coinbase Developer Platform account, create Paymaster project, get API key, whitelist our contract + function selectors (deposit, etc.), integrate Paymaster URL into wagmi config.

Cost to us: ~$0.005 per transaction. Budget monitoring required.

nodes.title: Ops: Admin dashboard for arbiter decisions
nodes.description:
Web page /admin (Discord-OAuth-gated to ADMIN_DISCORD_IDS): list of pending arbiter cases with collected evidence. One-click resolve actions.

Alternative to doing everything in Discord DMs. Cleaner for managing disputes at scale.
